question: Let $\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$. Find the area of the triangle formed by $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ as two sides taken from the same initial point.
explanation:
The area of the triangle formed by two vectors is $\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|$.

$\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & -2 & 3 \end{vmatrix}$.

$= \hat{i}(1\cdot3-(-2)(-2)) - \hat{j}(2\cdot3-(-2)(1)) + \hat{k}(2\cdot-2-1\cdot1)$.

$= -\hat{i} - 8\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}$.

$|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{(-1)^2+(-8)^2+(-5)^2} = \sqrt{90}$.

Area $= \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{90} = 3\sqrt{10}$.
